name: GrapesJS Studio
description: Create and edit websites and email designs with AI inside Claude. This server helps you generate new pages, update existing layouts, rewrite content, adjust styling, and build reusable sections faster. Whether you’re drafting a campaign email or shaping a full landing page, it keeps design and content work in one streamlined workflow.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GrapesJS Studio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GrapesJS Studio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.grapesjs.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GrapesJS Studio MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GrapesJS Studio provides these MCP tools: get_projects, load_project, get_project_files, get_project_file, prepare_asset_uploads, delete_assets, save_project, check_project_status, and initiate_project.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GrapesJS Studio?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GrapesJS Studio in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.

_published_faq.name: Does GrapesJS Studio MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: GrapesJS Studio requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GrapesJS Studio is developed by Grapes Studio Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
